title: Pics from my upcoming mall horror game.
content: Someone suggested this sub to me, so I hope this is okay. Just wanted to share some screenshots of my horror game I am developing. I wanted to make something from what I remember growing up as a kid. So I am heavily influenced by 90s and 80s aesthetic. The scenes are a work in progress, so there will be a lot more to be added and improved upon. The pics shown are a small part of the overall game, but I don't want to show off too much of the area before it is done. Hope all enjoy
